rationale.verdict: Insufficient on-chain evidence surfaced. Per-protocol context specifies chains 'BSquared, Bitcoin,' but fetched sources indicate Echo Protocol is primarily Aptos-deployed with BSquared integration; Bitcoin mainnet has no smart contracts. Official deployments doc, GitHub repo URL, and audit list are not provided in context and were not discovered via website/search. Block explorer searches for BSquared and Aptos not yet performed. Recommend clarifying canonical chain list and GitHub repo before next run.

evidence.shows: Echo Protocol homepage; references 'Echo Strategy', 'Echo Lending', and DeFi infrastructure for Bitcoin on Aptos. No contract addresses or deployment info listed.
Echo Protocol documentation describing how to bridge uBTC on BSquared to Aptos. References UniRouter on BSquared and bridging mechanics; no contract addresses provided.

Blog post from B² Network describing Echo Bridge integration. Confirms Echo Bridge was launched in July 2025, allowing bridging of uBTC from BSquared to Aptos in exchange for APT rewards. Approximately 2,000 BTC bridged at time of writing.

Echo Protocol is primarily deployed on Aptos blockchain. Smart contracts written in Move. Core components: Echo Vault, Echo Bridge smart contract for cross-chain unification. Mentions 'lz-echo-bridge' GitHub repo with LayerZero integration.

Echo Bridge description: bi-directional transfer of BTC between B2 network and Aptos. Mint/burn mechanism locks uBTC on B2, issues aBTC on Aptos. Validators and Submitters secure the bridge. No specific contract addresses listed.

Hacken audit of Echo Protocol Bridge for IOTA (not BSquared/Bitcoin). Audited Move-based implementation on IOTA side; EVM-side logic not in scope. This audit is not for the BSquared/Bitcoin-side bridge.
DeFiLlama listing of Echo Protocol TVL: $197.28m on Aptos, $190.41m on BSquared (as of latest snapshot). Confirms protocol operates on both chains; no contract addresses listed.

protocol_metadata.about: Echo Protocol is a Bitcoin liquidity aggregation and yield infrastructure layer for the Move ecosystem. It enables users to bridge BTC from BSquared (a BTC Layer 2) to Aptos, receiving aBTC (a liquid staking token backed 1:1 by BTC), and earning yield through Echo Lending, Echo Strategy, and liquid restaking products. The protocol is secured by validator and submitter networks and integrates with LayerZero for cross-chain operations.
